description: This file defines the implementation of the Fourcc class for handling video pixel formats and Fourcc codes, including conversions between different formats and external representations (V4L2, VAAPI). It includes functions for mapping pixel formats, generating string representations, and checking format properties.

classes.name: Fourcc
classes.description: A class representing Fourcc codes for video formats, with methods for conversion and property checks.

methods.name: Fourcc::FromUint32
methods.description: Creates a Fourcc object from a 32-bit unsigned integer if it matches known Fourcc codes.

methods.name: Fourcc::FromVideoPixelFormat
methods.description: Converts a VideoPixelFormat to a Fourcc code, considering whether the format is single-planar.

methods.name: Fourcc::ToVideoPixelFormat
methods.description: Converts a Fourcc code back to a VideoPixelFormat.

methods.name: Fourcc::ToString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the Fourcc code.

methods.name: Fourcc::IsMultiPlanar
methods.description: Checks if the Fourcc format is multi-planar.

methods.name: Fourcc::ToSinglePlanar
methods.description: Returns the single-planar version of the Fourcc format if applicable.
